evals.prompt: Run evals/files/make_qa_fixture.py --output fixture --mode clean. Use /scholarly-render-qa to audit fixture/publication into outputs/review, render twice, retain full-page rasters, and emit a release manifest only if mechanically eligible. Do not modify fixture/publication.
evals.baseline_prompt: Run evals/files/make_qa_fixture.py --output fixture --mode clean. Independently audit fixture/publication into outputs/review, render twice, retain full-page rasters, and emit a release manifest only if mechanically eligible. Do not modify fixture/publication.
evals.expected_output: Passing schema-valid QA evidence and a thin mechanical release index for an unchanged publication.
assertions: review/qa-evidence.json validates against assets/qa-evidence.schema.json, has mechanical_status pass, and contains each required core check exactly once with every blocking check passed.

The evidence binds the assembly manifest with path_base publication-root, both independent render PDFs and every raster with path_base evidence-root, and one retained full-page raster per page for the canonical PDF and both renders; render.repeatability evidence records passing normalized geometry and text comparisons.

review/release-manifest.json validates against assets/release-manifest.schema.json, has mechanical_status pass, hash-binds the assembly manifest with path_base publication-root, and hash-binds QA evidence with path_base release-root.
The before and after publication-tree fingerprints match, and human_review.status remains required.

evals.prompt: Run evals/files/make_qa_fixture.py --output fixture --mode seeded. Use /scholarly-render-qa to audit fixture/publication into outputs/review, render twice, retain full-page rasters, and emit a release manifest only if eligible. Do not repair the publication.
evals.baseline_prompt: Run evals/files/make_qa_fixture.py --output fixture --mode seeded. Independently audit fixture/publication into outputs/review, render twice, retain full-page rasters, and emit a release manifest only if eligible. Do not repair the publication.
evals.expected_output: Schema-valid failing QA evidence that records the seeded PDF observations and blocks release.
assertions: review/qa-evidence.json validates against assets/qa-evidence.schema.json, has mechanical_status fail, and contains at least one failed blocking core check.

The evidence observes that the canonical PDF uses A4 geometry instead of the declared Letter geometry, uses an undeclared or unembedded font, and sets unsafe_detected for a non-internal URI action with URI kind plus bounded page and target metadata when exposed.

Both independent render PDFs and complete raster sets are still bound relative to path_base evidence-root, the assembly manifest is bound relative to publication-root, detailed failures remain in the relevant checks, and the publication-tree before and after fingerprints match.
review/release-manifest.json is absent and the response does not claim release eligibility.

evals.prompt: Run evals/files/make_qa_fixture.py --output fixture --mode clean. Use /scholarly-render-qa to audit fixture/publication into outputs/review and report what remains after mechanical success. Keep every publication byte unchanged and do not claim that the audit completes human visual review.
evals.baseline_prompt: Run evals/files/make_qa_fixture.py --output fixture --mode clean. Independently audit fixture/publication into outputs/review and report what remains after mechanical success. Keep every publication byte unchanged and do not claim that the audit completes human visual review.
evals.expected_output: An immutable mechanical audit whose evidence explicitly leaves human review outstanding.
assertions: The QA evidence records matching before and after publication-tree fingerprints and passes publication.tree-unchanged.
The publication files and assembly manifest retain their original hashes and byte lengths after the audit.
The evidence has human_review.status required with a non-empty review scope even when mechanical_status is pass.
The release manifest remains a mechanical index and neither it nor the response claims completed human, editorial, or subject-matter approval.
